summary: Active stubble burning cluster detected with 215 fires (FRP: 676 MW) and 99% emission strength. Smoke corridor approaches NCR receptor communities in ~0.5 hours, exposing an estimated 7.1M residents (exposure range: 7,132,123 - 14,488,106). Immediate protective interventions mandated for Akash Hospital, Ballabgarh and Dayal Hospital, Faridabad before threshold exceedance.
